title: 第21章 装死第22章 苦情大戏
lines: 议事厅内众人皆惊。
所有目光都汇聚在范岱身上。
现场一片寂静，只剩下范岱添油加醋的哭诉，夹杂着断断续续的哀嚎。
范统一脸怒容。
他从没想过有人敢打范岱，所以进门时只当是摔重了。
哪曾想还真是挨打了。
还是被一个新来的给打了！
饶是范统忍性再好，当着所有部下的面，被人打了侄子，此时也压不住怒火。
“岂有此理！”
众人哪敢出声，只能垂首等着首领发话。
范岱索性坐在地上，继续哀嚎道，
“这次要是连吴谦都收拾不了，别说要抢药膳房，茅房都抢不着！”
眼看范岱把实话都喊出来，范统更急了，连忙制止道，
“闭嘴，你在胡说什么！”
众太监心中皆是一惊，终于明白范岱为何突然离开尚膳监，要去一个厨房做副总管。
虽然某些人有过猜测，但和范岱亲口说出，是两回事。
一时间，谁都不敢多说一个字，还后悔听见这个秘密，纷纷装聋作哑，想快点揭过此事。
范统又气又急，知道这早会是开不成了，便让众人退下。
众人如获大赦，争先恐后向外竞走。
“你被打到头了？什么都敢往外说！”
等现场安静下来，范统怒斥道。
若不是看范岱已经够惨，今天他真的有可能打人。
范岱说完就知道错了，但覆水难收，只能硬着头皮被骂。
见范统只是点到即止，并没有过分苛责，猜出应是伤势救了自己，连忙继续卖惨，
“何止打头，牙都给打掉了，大耳刮子扇多少，我昏了也没数清！”
“但都说打人不打脸，他这么打我，根本就没把咱尚膳监，没把咱范家放在眼里！”
“你要是再不给我报仇……我也不活了！”
范岱受此大辱，一心想报仇雪恨，否则在药膳房，哪还有半点颜面。
他就怕范统犯糊涂，说什么大局为重，让他慢慢筹谋。
这种丢人现眼的事，哪经得起等，若不能立即诛杀吴谦，哪怕后来把吴谦大卸八块，自己这辈子也抬不起头来。
范岱只能以死相逼，说完就要往后墙上撞。
范统心烦意乱，不耐烦的隔空一挥，用法术将范岱推倒在地。
“够了！”
content_en:
Everyone in the meeting hall was shocked.
All eyes were focused on Fan Dai.
The scene was silent, except for Fan Dai's embellished crying, mixed with intermittent wails.
Fan Tongyi looked angry.
He never thought that anyone would dare to hit Fan Dai, so he just thought it was a heavy fall when he entered the door.
I never thought I would really get beaten.
Still got beaten by a new guy!
No matter how tolerant Fan Tong was, he couldn't suppress his anger when his nephew was beaten in front of all his subordinates.
"That's unreasonable!"
No one dared to speak out, so they could only lower their heads and wait for the leader to speak.
Fan Dai simply sat on the ground and continued to cry,
"If even Wu Qian can't take care of it this time, let alone the medicated kitchen, we can't even grab the latrine!"
Seeing Fan Dai shouting out the truth, Fan Tong became even more anxious and quickly stopped him,
"Shut up, what nonsense are you talking about!"
All the eunuchs were shocked, and finally understood why Fan Dai suddenly left the Shangri-La Supervisor and went to work as the deputy general manager in a kitchen.
Although some people have speculated, it is completely different from Fan Dai saying it himself.
For a moment, no one dared to say one more word and regretted hearing the secret. They all pretended to be deaf and dumb, hoping to reveal the matter quickly.
Fan Tong was angry and anxious. Knowing that the morning meeting would not be held, he asked everyone to leave.
If everyone was granted amnesty, they rushed outside.
"You were beaten on the head? You dare to say anything!"
When the scene calmed down, Fan Tong angrily yelled.
If Fan Dai hadn't been miserable enough, he might have hit someone today.
After Fan Dai said it, he knew he was wrong, but he couldn't stop it, so he could only bite the bullet and be scolded.
Seeing that Fan Tong only pointed out that he was not too harsh, he guessed that his injury should have saved him, and he quickly continued to suffer.
"Not only did he hit his head, but all his teeth were knocked out. He was slapped so many times that I couldn't count them even after I fainted!"
"But they say that hitting someone doesn't hit the face. When he hit me like this, he didn't take our Shang Shan Supervisor or our Fan family seriously at all!"
"If you don't avenge me... I won't live anymore!"
Fan Dai was so humiliated that he wanted to take revenge, otherwise he would not have any dignity in the medicinal kitchen.
He was afraid that Fan Tong would be confused and say that the overall situation was the most important thing, so he asked him to plan slowly.
Such a humiliating thing could not withstand waiting. If Wu Qian could not be killed immediately, even if Wu Qian was torn into pieces later, he would not be able to hold his head up for the rest of his life.
Fan Dai could only threaten him with death, and after saying that, he would hit the back wall.
Fan Tong was upset and impatiently waved in the air, using magic to push Fan Dai to the ground.
"Enough!"
title_en: Chapter 21 Pretending to be dead Chapter 22 The drama of suffering
